verdict.rationale: A probe reports an official MCP server documented in the Buzz repo (docs/MCP_DRIVEN_HOOKS.md), and VISION_AGENT.md describes buzz-dev-mcp, a first-party MCP server that gives any agent a shell and file editor. Neither item shows an MCP server exposing Buzz's own channels, messages, repos or workflows to an external agent. The documented primary path for connecting agents is the ACP harness plus the Buzz CLI, not MCP. missing for 10: documented tool surface of a Buzz MCP server, setup/connection instructions for external agents, evidence the MCP server exposes Buzz workspace operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
